secrets.explanation: analytics-db is outside the coding agent's mcpServers list, so the agent cannot use this credential through the server. The name appears in a spec the agent can read.

uncertainties.message: Nothing here was observed at runtime. The view reads configuration only, so what a running tool enforced is not known.
GitHub declares no file roots, so the repositories it reaches are not declared.
Railway declares no file roots, so the projects and environments it reaches, production included, are not declared.
analytics-db declares no file roots, so the databases and schemas it reaches are not declared.
GITHUB_TOKEN, RAILWAY_TOKEN, and ANALYTICS_DATABASE_URL are referenced by name only; what each credential reaches is not inspected.
No rule names a workspace-files tool, so the view shows one operation for the whole server.
The coding agent's shell(git *) entry is compared with shell(git push:*) and the other git rules by prefix; flags and quoting are not parsed.
Routes through other agents, other providers, and the web are listed per operation as not modeled; they are not evaluated.
Whether a permitted command, such as go test, could print a credential from the environment is not determined.
Codex receives none of the allow, ask, or deny rules; only protected paths reach it, through a hook.
Cursor receives Read and Write rules for allow entries, but its documentation does not state how those patterns match, so they stay unresolved there.

supportedActions.description: Read this view for any subject and coding tool.
Validate a proposed change to the permission lists and see its impact on every subject. Nothing is written.
Applying a proposal is not supported. Copy the diff into the spec file, then run agnostic-ai sync.

effects.allowed: An allow rule wins: the tool runs the operation without asking.
effects.ask: An ask rule wins: the tool asks for approval each time.
effects.denied: A deny rule wins: the tool refuses the operation.
effects.unavailable: The subject's own scope leaves this route out; another route may still reach the same system.
effects.default: No rule applies, so the tool's own default decides.
effects.unresolved: The view cannot tell what this tool does with the declaration.

resolution.translated: The tool's own rule carries the decision, and how it matches is documented.
resolution.translated-unverified: The tool receives a rule, but how it matches is not documented, so the effect stays unresolved.
resolution.hook: A generated hook enforces the decision.
resolution.not-expressed: Declared, but sync writes nothing for it on this tool.
resolution.agent-scope: The subject's own spec decides, on a tool that reads agent tool lists.
resolution.no-rule: Nothing is declared; the tool's default applies.
resolution.disabled: The provider is switched off in its spec.

lists.allow: Project settings: operations the tool may run without asking.
lists.ask: Project settings: operations that need approval each time.
lists.deny: Project settings: operations the tool must refuse.
lists.protected: Protected paths: edits need the declared decision, here approval.
lists.can: The agent's own capability list; anything outside it is unavailable to the agent.
lists.tools: The agent's own tool list; anything outside it is unavailable to the agent.
lists.readonly: The agent is read-only; it may not change files.
lists.mcpServers: The MCP servers the agent may use; any other server is unavailable to it.

enforcement.native-rule: The tool's own permission rule carries the decision.
enforcement.hook: A generated hook carries the decision.
enforcement.not-expressed: Sync writes nothing for it; the tool's defaults apply.
enforcement.not-applicable: There is no decision to carry.

installed.stale: The generated file differs from disk, so the tool runs on an older version.
installed.not-generated: Sync has not written the generated file yet.
installed.not-checked: The generated file was not compared with disk.
installed.not-applicable: No generated file carries this decision.

rights.unavailable: The subject's scope leaves this right out.
rights.not-readable: The value is not in anything the subject can read.
rights.unknown: The view cannot determine this right.
